author: kkoryun
title: fusings_gpu pooling_f32_scale fp16_scale_out fails GPU unit test tolerance check
signature: gpu unit tests fusion pooling scale fp16 difference between val ref and val opt exceeds tolerance|Flaky Test

failed_jobs.name: GPU unit tests
failed_jobs.symptom: fusings_gpu/pooling_f32_scale.fp16_scale_out/1 fails a numeric tolerance assertion by a tiny margin (3.05e-05 vs 1e-05 tolerance)

key_errors:
fusion_test_common.hpp(90): error: The difference between val_ref[i] and val_opt[i] is 3.0517578125e-05, which exceeds tolerance, where
val_ref[i] evaluates to -0.04473876953125,
val_opt[i] evaluates to -0.044769287109375, and
tolerance evaluates to 9.9999997473787516e-06.
[  FAILED  ] fusings_gpu/pooling_f32_scale.fp16_scale_out/1
root_cause: The test compares fp16-precision pooling+scale fusion results against a reference using a fixed fp32-scale tolerance (1e-05). The observed deviation (~3.05e-05, one fp16 ULP at this magnitude) is consistent with legitimate fp16 rounding differences between the fused and unfused kernel execution paths on this runner's GPU, not with a logic defect introduced by the PR under test (whose changed files are in the unrelated NPUW CollapseUNQDQ transformation). This exact failure signature has now recurred 3 times in the last ~6.5 hours across unrelated PRs (#39548, #39826, #38855), confirming it is an existing flaky/borderline-tolerance GPU unit test rather than a regression caused by any of those PRs.
reproduction_steps: On a Windows GPU-capable runner: build the intel_gpu unit test target, then run `ov_gpu_unit_tests.exe --gtest_filter=fusings_gpu/pooling_f32_scale.fp16_scale_out/1` repeatedly; the comparison in src/plugins/intel_gpu/tests/unit/fusions/fusion_test_common.hpp around line 90 fails intermittently when the fp16 computed value differs from the reference by more than the fixed tolerance.
recommended_actions: Widen the tolerance (or use a relative/ULP-aware tolerance) for fp16 pooling+scale fusion comparisons in src/plugins/intel_gpu/tests/unit/fusions/fusion_test_common.hpp for the fp16_scale_out case
Investigate whether the fused vs non-fused kernel paths use different accumulation precision for this case and align them if feasible
Mark fusings_gpu/pooling_f32_scale.fp16_scale_out/1 as known-flaky/quarantined until the tolerance fix lands, to stop blocking unrelated merge-queue PRs
Add the verified log substring to the workflow rerunner's approved pattern list (proposed via propose_rerun_pattern) so future recurrences are retried automatically
prevention_strategies: Use adaptive or ULP-based tolerances for fp16 numeric comparisons in GPU fusion tests instead of a single fixed absolute epsilon, since fp16 rounding error scales with magnitude. Add CI-level tracking/quarantine for tests with a history of marginal tolerance failures so they do not falsely block unrelated merge-queue PRs.
historical_context: Same signature (7b64fedfacbfda60) previously recorded on 2026-11-13T23:41:12Z (run 43417057783, PR #38855) and 2026-11-14T02:42:46Z (run 43444472812, PR #39826); this is the 3rd occurrence within a 12-hour window, triggering the recurring-failure escalation.
